scope: Connected two-wide rename, checkpoints, 32-entry ROB, 64-entry PRF and 16-entry issue queue, driven by synthetic dispatch, completion, resolution and execution-port readiness. No execution units, memory launch, CSR/MMIO head state machine, frontend, physical issue/read/execute timing closure or complete OOO processor acceptance. Completions remain caller-supplied, so producer cancellation, age arbitration and commit-only head operations are still future work. This gate is full-size simulation, independent mutation testing and generic synthesis, not an integrated formal proof.
